description: Early inbound SMB. Small K-12 tutoring platform building a teacher-facing copilot and automated moderation for student submissions. Primary ask: low-latency chat for teacher and student workflows, reliable moderation for free-text responses, and an easy self-serve onboarding flow with clear cost math.
notes:
Discovery call 2026-02-18 (FF attached). Prospect: 3 founders, 12 full-time staff, ~1500 registered students. Tech: React frontend, Firebase backend, hosted on GCP (us-central1). Wants hosted API — no on-prem.

Key product needs / comments:
- Classroom copilot (teacher summarization, suggested feedback) — latency target: median <800ms for short prompts, acceptable tail up to 1200ms.
- Content moderation: auto-flag student submissions & chat messages; need explainability for flagged items.
- Cost sensitivity: target <$1,000/month for pilot (proof-of-value).
- Throughput: expected 300–1,000 messages/day during pilot; bursty at peak after lessons.
- Model preferences: open models preferred for cost; willing to test Redwood-curated mid-sized model.
- Routing/fallback: want simple fallback to cheaper model when budget threshold hit.

Timeline / activities:
- 2026-02-12: Signup via self-serve, initial API key requested.
- 2026-02-18: Discovery call with Maya + Diego (Fireflies ff-2026-02-18-8312). Discussed COPPA and FERPA concerns.
- 2026-02-25: Sent pricing sheet + minimal integration guide (drive link).
- 2026-03-01: Follow-up email; prospect requested sample cost estimate for 10k messages/month and moderation SLO details.

Quoted objections / verbal notes:
- "We need clear guardrails — teachers can't be blocked by false positives during class."
- "Budget is tight; we'll likely stop if costs exceed projection."

POC plan suggested by AE/SE:
- 14-day self-serve pilot on hosted_api with usage cap $750. Provide example batching and token-reduction tips from Redwood Optimize. Hook up moderation endpoint and sample prompt sets.
- If pilot shows acceptable QoE and moderation FP-rate < 2%, discuss moving to monthly commit (Dedicated considered after traction).

Next steps (owner):
- Send capped test org + onboarding checklist by 2026-03-03.
- Provide 2 example prompt templates for teacher summarization and 1 moderation policy mapping by 2026-03-05.

Misc links / artifacts:
- Pricing deck: drive://decks/apollo-sprout-redwood-pricing-v1
- Security FAQ sent: drive://security/apollo-privacy-questions-2026-02-18
- Jira ticket for moderation question: INF-412
